column3: The builders’ labor and the watchman’s wakefulness are completed actions. Watchman is singular.
The phrase is bread of toil, rather than a separate action of toiling for bread.
Sons are named specifically; there is no possessive attached directly to reward.
The phrase is sons of youth; born is not separately expressed.
They, not he, will not be ashamed when they speak with enemies at the gate. The man has actively filled his quiver.
